name: Organisation Administration
description: Ordinary organisation notices and privacy request cases for an organisation administrator.

permissions.label: Read activity
permissions.description: Read the current person's recent Activity, or the organisation audit view when independently authorised.

permissions.label: Create organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows the standard create operation for organisation notices.

permissions.label: Read organisation notices
permissions.description: Allows the standard read operation for organisation notices.

permissions.label: Update organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows the standard update operation for organisation notices.

permissions.label: Remove organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows the standard soft-delete operation for organisation notices.

permissions.label: Restore organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows the standard restore operation for organisation notices.

permissions.label: Export organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows the standard export operation for organisation notices.

permissions.label: Record organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows recording a draft organisation notice's text and publishing it.

permissions.label: Withdraw organisation notice
permissions.description: Allows withdrawing a published organisation notice.

permissions.label: Create privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows the standard create operation for privacy request cases.

permissions.label: Read privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows the standard read operation for privacy request cases.

permissions.label: Update privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows the standard update operation for privacy request cases.

permissions.label: Remove privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows the standard soft-delete operation for privacy request cases.

permissions.label: Restore privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows the standard restore operation for privacy request cases.

permissions.label: Export privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows the standard export operation for privacy request cases.

permissions.label: Record privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows recording a privacy request case and opening it as received.

permissions.label: Complete privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows closing a received privacy request case as completed.

permissions.label: Refuse privacy request case
permissions.description: Allows closing a received privacy request case as refused.

permissions.label: Read permissions
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected permission projection as a system record.

permissions.label: Read organisation settings
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected organisation settings projection as a system record.

permissions.label: Read installed applications
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected installed-application projection as a system record.

permissions.label: Read application role templates
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected application-role-template projection as a system record.
